Setiap episod membawa penonton mengikuti perjalanan yang dipenuhi tawa dan penemuan baharu, sambil menggalakkan kanak-kanak untuk belajar serta mengenali dunia di sekeliling mereka dengan cara yang menyeronokkan dan menarik.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Tertawan Hati
programme.desc: Alya dan Alyssa ialah pasangan kembar yang terpisah sejak lahir. Selepas 25 tahun, takdir menemukan mereka semula, dan mereka terkejut melihat wajah yang begitu seiras. Pertemuan itu merapatkan hubungan mereka, namun tanpa disedari pelbagai rahsia dan konflik mula terbongkar, mengubah kehidupan kedua-duanya.

programme.title: Jerit Malam Berujung Cinta
programme.desc: Karina, seorang gadis yang menyertai kelab pencinta alam telah mengalami kejadian misteri semasa aktiviti malam di hutan. Dia telah bertemu dengan Raka, seorang lelaki yang menyimpan rahsia gelap. Pelbagai peristiwa aneh dan menyeramkan mula berlaku, menguji keberanian dan kepercayaan mereka. Dalam usaha untuk menyelamatkan diri, mereka menemui cinta.

programme.title: ROOM NO. 7 ((7号室))
programme.desc: Doo-sik, a failing DVD room owner, and Tae-jung, a debt-ridden student, each hide some secrets in Room No. 7 of the store, sparking a darkly comic clash of secrets and survival. (杜,一个失败的DVD房主,和泰,一个债务的学生,)

programme.title: LOVE BARISTA ((爱情咖啡师))
programme.desc: Superstar Jun-woo is stranded in Vietnam with no passport and money. Barista Tao breaks his phone and offers him shelter. As their bond begins to blossom, scandals tear them apart... (大明星俊宇被困在越南,没有护照和钱。 陶达士打破电话,为他提供庇护。 随着他们的纽带开始开花,丑闻将他们撕裂...)

programme.title: Her Railway Trip (她的铁路旅行)
programme.desc: Japans railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname Tetsuko meaning railway girl. The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether youre a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, Tetsukos Lofty Mountain offers a romantic and surprising railway journey. (日本铁路世界千差万别,从风景山谷到海岸线。 每条火车的车窗都像一幅风景绘画,吸引了铁路爱好者。近年来,它也吸引了许多妇女,产生了一个独一无二的叫Tetsuko的绰号叫Tetsuko的火车女郎。这个由即将上台的女演员Ni Jiawen和He Yongsao牵头的节目,通过日本铁路旅行的魅力,让观众走上旅程。它不仅介绍铁路本身,还探索铁路横跨的地道和城市,展示铁路和城镇交织创造的独特景观。不管你是铁路爱好者还是观光者,都喜欢探索新的文化,Tetsukos Lofty山提供了一条浪漫和令人惊讶的铁路旅程。)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))

(随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. (据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: Another Era ((再创世纪))
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry (2008年,随着金融混乱的海淹没世界,雄心勃勃的企业家霍廷山·库克春· (Ho Tin-Sang Kwok Chun On) 看到机会寻求接管香港最富有的人,春的武功商业帝国,但被另一位商界巨头克凯·普恩干预.他对他的仇恨,桑一直在寻求报复.十年后,现在最富有的克家族被不幸所遮蔽.凯的儿子突然去世是对凯的压倒性打击,他因心脏病发作而昏迷.为了让他们的业务继续前进,他的未经验的年轻女儿克戴,小·,与私人代理人克,克和克,克-克,克)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Walking With You ((仨心友行))
programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. This trip to Malaysia was a rare girls getaway, filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. They visited durian orchards to enjoy fresh Musang King durians, picked vegetables and coconuts in vegetable gardens, explored the rainforest, and visited luxurious houses, experiencing a different side of Malaysia. The four friends also shared heartfelt conversations with their guests, revealing their true selves. (沙龙,萨曼塔·科,卡蒂·库恩和格雷斯·是娱乐界的亲密朋友.这次前往马来西亚的旅行是一次罕见的女孩逃生,充满美味的食物,有趣的活动,体验当地文化.在旅行期间,四位美丽的主持人每个人邀请了他们的朋友莱洛基,马特·叶恩和马库恩加入他们,前往塞兰戈尔,帕汉,特伦格努,凯兰坦和萨巴.他们访问了榴树园来享受新鲜的Musan King榴树,在蔬菜园中摘取蔬菜和子,探索雨林,并访问了豪华的房屋,体验了马来西亚的不同面.四位朋友也与他们的客人分享了真诚的对话,揭示了他们的自我.)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. When Mancer discovers and finds solace in stand-up comedy, he learns that hardships provide the best comedic material - from his own school ridicule experience to pandemic woes, misery can fuel laughter! (Mancer知道父亲Wah年轻时在智力上受到挑战,在母亲离开后必须照顾他。 当Mancer发现并找到立体喜剧中的安慰时,他了解到困难提供了最好的喜剧材料 — — 从他在学校的嘲弄经历到大灾难,痛苦会激起欢笑!)

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man ((百变星君))
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love. (歌手是一个在国外留学的富人,但被宠坏了,他永远无法专心于学习,而是花时间与女孩调情。 有一天,当他和情妇西尔维娅勾搭在一起时,歌手被黑帮吹了起来。 这个傲慢的恶作剧者被复活了,成了一个拥有独特技能、真正工作和新的真爱的无法打败的半机械人。)

programme.title: The Sleep Curse ((乱马½))
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, a young translator colluded with the enemy and was cursed by a murdered comfort woman. Forty five years later, the translators son who is a professor specializing in sleeping disorder does not believe in the sleep curse on his father and tries to dispel it with a horrifying sleep experiment. (在日本占领香港期间,一位年轻的翻译与敌人勾结,被一位被谋杀的慰安妇诅咒。 四十五年后,一位专门研究睡眠障碍的翻译儿子不相信他父亲的睡眠诅咒,并试图用可怕的睡眠实验来消除这种诅咒。)

programme.title: Demi-Haunted ((魂魄唔齐))
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Feis ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish (Wan Fei是一位有前途的中国歌剧歌手,他暗中爱上了一位名叫江峰的人。她想为他唱歌,但死于一场悲剧性事故。 几年后,Wan Feis的鬼魂回来了,发现她的精神的一部分已经以中国年轻歌剧歌手Chor Bai的形式转世。 这终于让Wan Fei实现了她的愿望。)

programme.title: Golden Boy ((金童))
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son. (在监狱服刑十年后,前拳击手张立首次见到儿子。 被迫共同生活是为了继承遗产,这是为重建信任而争斗的一对纷争。 当张乐返回拳击场争取救赎的最后一击时,他必须面对过去,与儿子为未来而斗争。)

programme.title: Dead Talents Society ((诡才之道))
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must fight to prove herself in the afterlife, where spirits are required to deliver spectacular scares to earn their place. Facing the threat of vanishing if she fails to secure a haunting license, she teams up with a washed-up ghost diva and her spectral agent, who train her to become the next star and stage the worlds greatest fright. (Newbie 幽灵Rookie必须战斗以证明自己在来世,在后世,灵魂必须提供壮观的吓唬以赢得他们的位置。 面对如果她不能获得一个漫无目的的许可证而消失的威胁,她与一个被冲洗的幽灵Diva和她的光谱特工联手,后者训练她成为下一个明星并给世界带来最可怕的情景。)

programme.title: P Storm ((恐龙战队))
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of a rich mans son bribing prison guards to cover up his criminal activities in the prison to the ICAC. ICAC Chief Officer Luk goes undercover in prison to conduct his investigation. Despite the risks involved, Luk is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang. (平平向廉政公署报告一宗富人儿子贿赂狱警以掩盖他在狱中犯罪活动的案件,廉政公署总长Luk在狱中卧底进行调查,尽管有风险,卢克仍决心在狱友王的帮助下完成任务。)

programme.title: Good Game ((高手过招))
programme.desc: Several down-and-out individuals find a spark in esports. From a cybercaf to the competitive arena, they form team Happy Hour, battling rivals and lifes setbacks to reclaim a second chance. (从网络咖啡馆到竞技场,他们组成了“欢乐一小时”团队,与竞争对手和生活挫折抗争,以重获第二次机会。)

programme.title: All Suspects ((全员嫌疑人))
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a BB, sharing the space with a detective novelist, a homeless drifter and a pianist. However, when the owner and the receptionist are found dead, the peaceful retreat turns into a web of suspicion and deceit. Each guest becomes both suspect and sleutheach guarding a secret that could unravel the entire mystery. (休假的警察检查了BB,与侦探小说家、无家可归的流浪者和钢琴家共享空间。 但是,当发现主人和接待员死亡时,和平撤退就变成了猜疑和欺骗的网络。 每一位客人都成为嫌疑犯,并隐匿着可能揭开整个谜团的秘密。)

programme.title: Guilt By Design ((催眠·裁决))
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. The abductors demand that he hypnotize the jury to manipulate the final verdict. Torn between justice and family, he must decide how far he is willing to go to save her. (在香港令人震惊的谋杀案审判的最后一天,一位著名的催眠疗法医生担任陪审员,他收到一段录像,显示他的女儿被绑架。 绑架者要求他催眠陪审团,以操纵最终判决。 在司法和家庭之间,他必须决定他愿意如何拯救她。)

programme.title: Valley of the Shadow of Death ((不赦之罪))
programme.desc: Years after his daughters brutal death, the perpetrator reappears in church seeking forgiveness. Confronted with grief that never healed, Pastor Leung is torn between faith and vengeance. As buried emotions resurface and truths unravel, he faces a profound moral reckoning, forcing him to choose between justice and forgiveness. (女儿死后多年,凶手再次出现在教堂求饶。 面对从未愈合的悲痛,梁牧师在信仰和复仇之间被撕裂。 随着被埋藏的情感重新浮现,真理破灭,他面临着深刻的道德清算,迫使他在正义和宽恕之间做出选择。)

programme.title: A Murder Erased ((被消失的凶案))
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a death scene investigation where the deceased body had laid undiscovered for eight years. A prosecutor joins the investigation after Choi has identified the suspect, and finds Chois actions suspicious when all manner of inconsistencies come to light from his statement... (崔警官被指派进行死亡现场调查,死者的尸体在调查中8年未被发现。 在崔警官查明嫌疑人后,检察官加入调查,发现Chois在陈述中发现各种不一致之处时可疑。)

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman ((Return of 一代剑王 一代劍王))
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas pursuit. (一群忍者屠杀了整个武当族,并陷害了不可战胜的族长杜国武迪。 云掌握了武术的风格,决定通过挑战吴迪来报复氏族,但被击败和严重伤害。 幸运的是,李师傅拯救并治疗了他,让云能避免忍者追逐。)

programme.title: The Adulteress (淫妇)
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, shes soon framed for her husbands murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense (更糟糕的是,她很快就被强奸犯,当地地方法官的儿子,陷害丈夫谋杀了。 即便如此,在这种情绪悬念中,她的痛苦也并非结束。)

programme.title: The Bride from Hell ((鬼新娘))
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain mens life essence. With a Taoists help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell. (方明娶了神秘的年轻女士梁秋平,只为了发现她是一个被迫消耗男人生命精华的精神。 在道教的帮助下,他将她从邪恶的力量中解救出来,但他们的爱无法跨越生死,他们黎明时分就以苦痛的告别告别。)

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber ((霹雳十杰))
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too. (刘高登在最后的三部曲中, 在试图保护方世玉时, 重现了自己的著名角色, 圣德僧人,他试图保护方世玉,)

programme.title: Men From The Gutter ((暗渠))
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime. (有两个截然不同的警察去抓一个当地的毒枭。在这个摇头丸犯罪惊险片中,两个警察去做他们的工作是不一样的——一个是照法律的文字做,另一个是照法律的文字做,另一个只是尽力去解决犯罪。)

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother ((书剑恩仇录))
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles (皇帝强龙并非生来王位的合法继承者,但他只有在两个颠覆性反政府秘密组织的高级成员多年后与他联系时才知道真相。 诚如事实,这个组织的主管是秦龙的弟弟,他们现在必须相互对抗,扮演对立的角色。)

programme.title: Call of the Sea ((彻夜之歌))
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yus beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair... (青少年渔民,胡爱上了他的童年朋友宇.然而,一个镇上暴徒的唯一的儿子渴望宇的美丽,并试图尽可能地接近她.胡有一天保护另一个女人免受暴徒的侵害,导致宇误解他并怀疑他们有着情侣关系.)

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World ((武林圣火令))
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chous parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents deaths. (天的父母被一对火焰状刀子杀害.他和他的姐姐被英雄和恶棍分别救援,抚养和训练,每个继承了刀子中的一个.起初他们宣誓敌人,最终揭露了他们的真实身份,并联合起来报复父母的死亡.)

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow ((女秀才))
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her! (华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情: 华盛顿歌剧剧情)

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword ((浣花洗剑录))
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot (水族首领在大湖一年一度的决斗前不久,被一名武士杀手严重打伤,他派哥哥宝羽远途寻找解药。 在路上,宝玉遇到了小公主,爱上了她,不知道她隐藏了一个秘密阴谋。)

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung ((乾隆下江南))
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter. (龙皇帝不知名地前往江南审查他人民的生计,但很快发现腐败官员正在压迫他的人民.皇帝遇到了一个正直的年轻人,他们携手教腐败官员一个教训.年轻人被任命为他的保卫.)

programme.title: The Deadly Duo ((双侠))
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive. (宋朝的王子被钦族入侵者抓获,由武术大师顶尖看守。 有两个强大的爱国者需要克服巨大的困难,拉出不可能的:拯救王储并活着离开钦族据点。)

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By ((当云匆匆消散时))
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love. (苏是一个精神分裂症患者,她拒绝相信她的飞行员爱人在飞机事故中丧生,并发明故事来处理事情.她遇到了老同学莱,他也是医生,他找到了治疗她的疾病的方法.苏慢慢恢复并接受现实,以及她的新发现的爱.)

programme.title: The Daredevils ((The 夜魔侠s))
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called The Venoms, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms! (腐败的王利将军通过杀害上司而掌权。 被谋杀的上司的儿子与四位街头表演者建立了朋友关系,他们称毒瘾为“毒瘾 ” ( The Venoms ), 他们帮助他复仇,假扮政府官员向腐败的上将提供和平象征。 当王上将抵达仓库时,他被毒瘾伏击!)

programme.title: Sweet And Wild ((野姑娘))
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back? (是一个的村子女孩,她不怕反击暴徒.她遇到了最大的子的麻烦,当她与女仆打败他的计划时,让策划复仇.)

programme.title: Tragic Commitment ((没有老公的日子))
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby... (当一位医生的丈夫东先生在一次事故中受致命伤时,他向她透露了他与小黑的婚外情,他与小黑怀孕了。 尽管背叛的破坏和丈夫最终死亡,但她婆婆还是施加压力,要她忍受小黑,为她的孩子提供1M。)

programme.title: The Human Goddess ((仙女下凡))
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins. (第七修女,一位来自天堂的好奇仙女,降至1970年代的香港。 迷失在一个陌生的世界中,她被一个负债累累的孤儿院的东志拉普拯救。 当一个大亨用地夺取土地时,她利用自己的力量保护土地,而一个不可能发生的浪漫开始。)

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty ((血芙蓉))
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hons pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back... (飞行国联刺客秘密为皇帝工作,其领导人金正日被派去杀害知道这个秘密的金安。 怀孕的夫人荣阁下试图杀死金,但为了保护她未出生的孩子而撤退。 当她被搜身时,荣与前飞行国联成员及其武术高年级成员勾搭起来反击。)

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman ((丹下左膳 妖刀濡れ燕))
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her. (独臂剑客方康想和妻子过平静的生活,但当她被八大恶魔剑客氏团绑架时,他被迫带着他们去救她。)

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody ((花月良宵))
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer Li Ching, the daughter of a deceased magician friend. (香港Rhapsody是一个音乐剧场外的歌舞剧!)

programme.title: Five Superfighters ((唐山五虎))
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their masters birthday. (一个功夫大师和他的三个学生在被一个恶霸压倒之后失去了一切。 为了报复,学生们找到了向其他武术大师学习的方法,并在六个月后回来,在他们的恶霸生日上与恶霸重新比赛。)

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall ((王昭君))
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself. (王赵军拒绝贿赂帝国画家,因此他画了一张她丑陋的肖像,阻止她被皇帝选中,直到他们见面。 画家最终流亡在外,并阴谋让王朝嫁给洪军阀,以报仇。 皇帝拒绝了这一提议,挑起一场战争,只有王王自祭才能避免战争。)

programme.title: King Cat ((小明和王猫))
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time? (拜大法官以贪污罪将帝国教父之子斩首。 愤怒的是,老师雇用刺客去杀害被钱赵救活的宝,同时,在谋杀发生时,王室宝藏被盗。 宝奉命十天后破案,张大法官迅速着手调查。 他们能及时破案吗?)

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛出獄記))
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity? (这场片面的喜剧看到天真阿牛来到香港,在那里他一再被剥削和利用,最终被捕入狱! 他能度过艰难的时光,克服逆境吗?)

programme.title: The Fastest Sword ((天下第一剑))
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named The Fastest Sword but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally? (南剑客丁(Southern Swordsman Ting)名为“最快之剑 ”, 但却被街头和尚打败,必须履行他的承诺,在与和尚一起渴望的石碑上工作三年。 之后,丁回到家乡过着和平的生活,并减少了所有挑战。 即使如此,他还是被迫与北剑侠作战。谁能最终获胜?)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: World-renowned survivalist Bear Grylls leads Zac Efron on a non-stop extreme survival journey into the Northeast Appalachian mountain range wilderness. (世界知名的生存主义者大熊格瑞尔斯带领Rac Efron 前往阿巴拉契亚东北山脉荒野,)

programme.title: Tiger Island ((虎岛))
programme.desc: Returning to Nepal, the film crew use thermal cameras and drones to follow tigers after dark, revealing a hidden world of previously unseen behaviour and surprise encounters. (影片摄制组回到尼泊尔后, 使用热摄像头和无人机跟踪老虎,)

programme.title: Big Adventures: Into Thailand with Sue Perkins (伟大的冒险:与苏·珀金斯一起去泰国)
programme.desc: Sue heads south to the enticing turquoise waters of Phuket, the countrys largest island. Making her diving debut, she learns how destructive humans can be to the fragile coral reefs. (苏向南走去普吉岛这个最大的岛屿的令人羡慕的绿绿洲水域。 在她首次潜水时,她学会了人类对脆弱珊瑚礁的破坏力。)

programme.title: Ancient Powers ((亘古文明))
programme.desc: In an unpredictable world our ancient powers must lay down the foundations of their societies to show their strength and protect their people. Who will build their way to glory? (在一个不可预知的世界中,我们的古代强国必须奠定其社会的基础,展示其力量并保护其人民。 谁将建设其光荣之路?)

programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls ((名人荒野求生))
programme.desc: World-renowned survivalist Bear Grylls leads Zac Efron on a non-stop extreme survival journey into the Northeast Appalachian mountain range wilderness. (世界知名的生存主义者大熊格瑞尔斯带领Rac Efron 前往阿巴拉契亚东北山脉荒野,)

programme.title: Airborne ((中文))
programme.desc: Go hunting with flyers who excel at making mid-air catches. Watch the metamorphosis of the acrobatic emperor dragonfly, admire the barn owls stealthy approach to prey, and catch a wandering salamanders death-defying leap into the abyss. (随着飞行员们的精力,去狩猎. 观看形的皇帝龙的变化,欣赏收仓猫头偷偷地接近猎物, 捕捉一个流浪的鱼, 跳进深.)

programme.title: Animals Like Us ((拟人动物))
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner. (探索为什么肯尼亚需要一个村庄来养狮子幼崽,并探究马达加斯加的香狐猴交配策略。 在蜜蜂舞会上剪地毯,然后作为叉尾大龙来倾听其他鸟类的晚餐。)

programme.title: Animals Like Us ((拟人动物))
programme.desc: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster. (帮助鲨鱼维持珍珠白的牙齿鱼的神话, 并发现海豚家族的标志性呼声。 检查卡布金猴子的坚果碎石工具, 在长颈鹿吸食时得到温暖的狐狸, 并见到一个黑手党暴徒。)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running With The Pack (野狗:与群众一起跑)
programme.desc: Connect with the three packs: the large Manzi pack in the lush heartland, the Kakuli pack in the Badlands, and the tiny Stork Colony pack living at the parks edge. Follow Julz as he shares their victories and defeats in this make-or-break season. (与这三包土地相连:在冰冷的心脏地带的大型曼齐包、在巴德兰的卡库利包和在公园边缘生活的小斯托克殖民地包。 跟随朱尔兹,他分享了他们的胜利和在这一成败季节的失败。)

programme.title: Animals Like Us ((拟人动物))
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. programme.title: Planet Weird ((星際姊妹))
programme.desc: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi. (面对大自然最想要的事物,看看为什么最坏的坏人得不到应有的尊重。 迎接伟大的白鲨电感器、死亡的叶的剃刀和僵尸造物力。)

programme.title: Surviving The Amazon ((挑战亚马逊))
programme.desc: Every year, more than 200,000 monkeys in Peru are trafficked illegally. Almost all are babies. Watch as these little ones learn to survive without their moms and try to make new friends along the way. (每年,秘鲁有超过20万只被非法贩卖.几乎所有都是婴儿.)

programme.title: Alaskan Summer ((阿拉斯加之夏))
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for its wildlife. (每天近20小时的阳光为丰盛的季节提供食物。温暖释放了冰川、冰洞和瀑布的水。 水撞入了无数的内河口,养活森林和野生动物。 从6月到8月,阿拉斯加成为野生动物的天堂。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators. (赞比亚的野生动物是生活难以生存的地方. 在这里,许多动物必须团结起来,帮助保护领土,保护后代,寻找食物和战胜掠食者.)

programme.title: Into The Wild Colombia ((进入野外：哥伦比亚))
programme.desc: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe. (长大的在哥伦比亚的中心雨林, 一个年轻的子子必须掌握他的爬山技巧, 学会如何找到食物,)

programme.title: Airborne ((中文))
programme.desc: Check in with animals who are winners at the aerial mating game. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner. (探索为什么肯尼亚需要一个村庄来养狮子幼崽,并探究马达加斯加的香狐猴交配策略。 在蜜蜂舞会上剪地毯,然后作为叉尾大龙来倾听其他鸟类的晚餐。)

programme.title: Animals Like Us ((拟人动物))
programme.desc: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkeys nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster. (帮助鲨鱼维持珍珠白的牙齿鱼的神话, 并发现海豚家族的标志性呼声。 检查卡布金猴子的坚果碎石工具, 在长颈鹿吸食时得到温暖的狐狸, 并见到一个黑手党暴徒。)

programme.title: Planet Weird ((星際姊妹))
programme.desc: Meet natures most wanted and see why the baddest of the bad dont get the respect they deserve. Admire the great white sharks electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis, and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi. (面对大自然最想要的事物,看看为什么最坏的坏人得不到应有的尊重。 迎接伟大的白鲨电感器、死亡的叶的剃刀和僵尸造物力。)

programme.title: Surviving The Amazon ((挑战亚马逊))
programme.desc: Every year, more than 200,000 monkeys in Peru are trafficked illegally. Almost all are babies. Watch as these little ones learn to survive without their moms and try to make new friends along the way. (每年,秘鲁有超过20万只被非法贩卖.几乎所有都是婴儿.)

programme.title: Alaskan Summer ((阿拉斯加之夏))
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for its wildlife. (每天近20小时的阳光为丰盛的季节提供食物。温暖释放了冰川、冰洞和瀑布的水。 水撞入了无数的内河口,养活森林和野生动物。 从6月到8月,阿拉斯加成为野生动物的天堂。)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: The wilds of Zambia are a tough place to live. Here, many animals must come together in groups to help defend territory, protect offspring, find food and overcome predators. (赞比亚的野生动物是生活难以生存的地方. 在这里,许多动物必须团结起来,帮助保护领土,保护后代,寻找食物和战胜掠食者.)

programme.title: Into The Wild Colombia ((进入野外：哥伦比亚))
programme.desc: Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe. (长大的在哥伦比亚的中心雨林, 一个年轻的子子必须掌握他的爬山技巧, 学会如何找到食物,)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running With The Pack (野狗:与群众一起跑)
programme.desc: Feel the heat as rising temps mean that water is getting scarce. The Manzi pack must stand alongside predators to hydrate at a remaining precious water spot. programme.title: Planet Weird ((星際姊妹))
programme.desc: Unravel strange alliances that ensure mutual success in the wild. Explore the partnership between clownfish and anemones, watch oxpeckers keep savannah residents healthy, and review the quid-pro-poo agreements of dung beetles and pitcher plants. (能够确保野外相互成功的无比奇异的联盟。 探索小丑鱼和蚂蚁之间的伙伴关系,观察公牛保持稀树草原居民的健康,并审查粪便甲壳虫和投手植物的双赢协议。)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Watch summer unfold in the Northern Hemisphere, while regions close to the equator enter the wet season and Southern Africa goes dry, creating scarcity for some creatures and bounty for others. (在北半球,夏天的光,在赤道附近的地区进入潮季节,南非干燥,)

programme.title: A Wild Year On Earth ((狂野地球))
programme.desc: Witness some of the planets most dramatic natural shifts in July, from the Arctic ice sheets that come crashing down during the summer melt to the feeding frenzy when sockeye salmon reach the end of their journey in Alaska. (7月,一些行星发生了最剧烈的自然变化, 从夏季的北极冰盖崩塌到 袜子鲑鱼到达阿拉斯加旅程的尽头时,)

programme.title: Tales From Zambia ((赞比亚传奇))
programme.desc: Everyday in the Luangwa Valley a carcass is sighted. Each body holds the story that lead them to their death. In Safari CSI we investigate what killed three carcasses that have been uncovered... (在卢安加瓦谷每天都会看到一个尸体,每个尸体都包含了导致他们死亡的故事. 在萨法里,我们调查了被发现的三具尸体的死因.)

programme.title: Into The Wild Colombia ((进入野外：哥伦比亚))
programme.desc: From Colombias high plains of the Pramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs. (从哥伦比亚的普拉莫高原到热带森林,蜂鸟已经演变成数量惊人的物种。 无论与冻雨或丛林掠食者抗争,每个母亲都必须努力建立巢穴,保护她的卵。)

programme.title: 증시 오늘과 내일
programme.desc: 오늘 장 전문가의 매수종목으로 수익률 극대화, 오늘 장 마감정리와 내일 장까지 대비합니다. 막판 공략주를 통해 갈팡질팡한 시청자들의 마음을 사로잡는 증시 오늘과 내일!!

programme.title: 부당거래

programme.title: 헌트
programme.desc: 낯선 사람들과 함께 의문의 지역에 갇혀 영문도 모른 채 사냥 당하고 있는 크리스탈베티 길핀이 자신들을 사냥하는 주체를 밝히고, 그들을 찾아 복수하기 위해 고군분투하는 이야기

programme.title: 노인을 위한 나라는 없다
programme.desc: 평범한 일상을 보내던 카우보이가 우연히 살인사건에 휘말리면서 벌어지는 이야기를 다룬 범죄드라마. 2008년 아카데미 작품상을 비롯한 4개 부문 수상작

programme.title: 진주만
programme.desc: 1941년 12월 7일 있었던 일본군의 미 진주만 습격을 정면으로 다룬 2001년 여름 헐리웃 최대 블럭버스터. 진주만 폭격에 맞서 싸운 두명의 미 조종사가 1942년 4월 18일 도쿄와 주요 도시를 폭격한 둘리틀 공습Doolittle raid에 참가하기까지를 영웅적으로 그린 대작

programme.title: 범죄와의 전쟁

programme.title: 엑시트

programme.title: 보이스
